description: Start attaching a user-owned domain to an existing site: returns the DNS records the user adds at their DNS provider (a routing record that sends visitors here, plus a TXT that proves ownership). Idempotent: the same siteName and domain return the existing record. Once the records are published (usually minutes, up to 24h), call verify_custom_domain with the returned recordId; VibeDeploy also re-checks automatically for a few days and emails the user when the domain is live. The site must already exist; call deploy_site first if it does not.

domain.description: The user-owned hostname to attach, e.g. 'shop.example.com'. Must be a valid FQDN.

siteName.description: The VibeDeploy site name to attach the domain to (e.g. 'tester').

name: add_custom_domain

alreadyAttached.description: True when the call returned an existing record instead of creating one (idempotent path).

dnsAutoConfigured.description: True when the verification TXT was written automatically (domain registered through VibeDeploy): call verify_custom_domain right away. Otherwise the user adds the record at their DNS provider first.

dnsProvider.description: The provider that hosts the domain's DNS, recognised from its nameservers. Absent when unknown.

helpUrl.description: The provider's own help article on DNS records, when known.

name.description: The company that hosts the domain's DNS, e.g. Combell, OVHcloud, Cloudflare.

panelUrl.description: Where the user logs in to edit the DNS records.

steps.description: Steps specific to this provider, in order. Relay them with the records.

dnsRecords.description: Every record to add at the DNS provider: routing (sends visitors to VibeDeploy), ownership (TXT) and the optional www/apex twin. Only present when status is pending_verification.

host.description: Value for the provider's Host/Name field ('@' is the domain itself).

nextCall.description: Structured hint for the next tool call (e.g. verify_custom_domain). Lets an agent chain without parsing instructions.

recordId.description: Pass this to verify_custom_domain after the TXT is in place.

status.description: pending_verification on first attach; verified if the domain was already set up earlier.

verificationRecord.description: Only present when status is pending_verification.

host.description: What to type in the DNS provider's Host/Name field (e.g. '_vibedeploy.shop'); most providers append the domain themselves.

title: Attach a custom domain (step 1 of 2)
